Physician specializing in Otolaryngology

Accomplishment
1. A fellow of the American Academy of Ophthalmology and Otolaryngology and the American College of Surgeons (F.A.C.S.)

2. A member of the American Medical Association, Kansas Medical Society, Shawnee County Medical Society

3. A supporter and volunteer at the Marian Clinic

4. Was recognized as a distinguished community leader by the Topeka Public Schools Multicultural Task Force for his commitment to fostering intercultural understanding and diversity, 1990

5. A lifetime member of the North American Taiwanese Medical Association and served as President of the Kansas Chapter

6.Served on the boards of the Taiwanese United Fund and Formosan Association of Public Affairs
